replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body: Then it has to be you're facing people with very low ping. If you have extremely high ping, let's say 1000, your hit will take 1 second to register (correct me if I'm wrong). If you have extremely low ping, like 20, then your hit will take only 20 milliseconds to register and people with normal ping like 100 will have a hard time hitting them because you get a hit delay where as they don't get any ):
